enabled.description: Enable or disable the netconfd service overall.

log_level.description: Minimum logging level: debug, info, notice, warning, error, critical.

log_file.description: Path to the log file; use 'stdout' to log to console.

pid_file.description: Path where the process PID file is written.

max_sessions_per_user.description: Maximum number of concurrent sessions allowed per authenticated user.

max_sessions_total.description: Maximum total number of concurrent sessions across all users.

session_timeout.description: Session inactivity timeout in seconds (0 disables timeout).

ssh_host_key.description: Path to the SSH private host key file.

ssh_authorized_keys.description: Path to the SSH authorized_keys file for public key authentication. Optional.

tls_cert.description: Path to the TLS certificate chain file.

tls_key.description: Path to the TLS private key file.

tls_ca_cert.description: Optional CA certificate for mutual TLS client verification.

restconf_tls_cert.description: Optional TLS certificate for RESTCONF (overrides global TLS cert).

restconf_tls_key.description: Optional TLS key for RESTCONF (overrides global TLS key).

validate_yang_on_startup.description: Validate YANG modules and configuration at startup.

yang_module_paths.description: List of directories to search for YANG modules.

startup_config.description: Path to the NETCONF :startup configuration file (XML format).

candidate_config.description: Path to the NETCONF :candidate configuration file (XML format).

running_config.description: Path to the NETCONF :running configuration file (XML format).

notification_streams_dir.description: Directory containing YANG stream definition modules (e.g., ietf-netconf-notifications).

extensions.description: List of additional NETCONF protocol extensions to load. Each element defines path and optional arguments.

path.description: Path to the extension plugin/shared library.

args.description: Optional comma-separated arguments for the extension.

users.description: List of authenticated users with access to NETCONF.

password.description: Optional plaintext password (for testing only). Use empty string and rely on public key.

public_key.description: Path to the user's public key file (for SSH public key auth).

role.description: User role: admin, operator, or reader.
